title: Operator vs Hilbert–Schmidt norm, distance to a subspace, and the projection trace identity
statement:
(i) For all m, k and every linear map A : R^m → R^k, ‖A‖ <= |A|, where ‖A‖ is the operator norm and |A| = (Σ_i |A e_i|^2)^{1/2} = hsNorm A is the Hilbert–Schmidt norm (e_i the standard basis).
(ii) For every linear subspace T ⊆ R^m and v ∈ R^m, |p_{T⊥} v| = dist(v, T), where p_{T⊥} is the orthogonal projection onto T⊥.
(iii) For linear subspaces P, T ⊆ R^m with dim P = dim T, trace(p_{T⊥} ∘ p_P) = (1/2)|p_P − p_T|^2, where |·|^2 = hsNormSq.
lean_statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), ‖A‖ ≤ hsNorm A) ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)) (v : Rn m), ‖Tᗮ.starProjection v‖ = Metric.infDist v (T : Set (Rn m))) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (P T : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), Module.finrank ℝ P = Module.finrank ℝ T → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn m) (Tᗮ.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap) = hsNormSq (P.starProjection - T.starProjection) / 2
